_readme: News, events and promotions shown on /events/. This file is CONTENT, not site copy:
it deliberately lives outside translations.js and i18n/*.json, so news items never
appear in the i18n coverage report and never need a lock-file entry.
It is written by hand today and by the /admin/ publisher later, so keep it plain:
no comments, no trailing commas, one object per item.
id        stable slug. Used as the anchor and the JSON-LD @id. Never reuse one.
type      news | event | promotion  -> which of the three sections it renders in.
date      ISO yyyy-mm-dd. News/promotions sort newest first; events sort soonest first.
dateEnd   optional ISO, events spanning more than one day.
location  optional, events only.
published false hides it everywhere without deleting it (drafts).
url       optional. Renders a 'Read more' link; external links open in a new tab.
image     optional, site-root-relative (e.g. /assets/images/news/foo.jpg).
en/cs/pl  { title, summary }. en is required; a missing language falls back to en,
matching how translations.js already behaves.
An event whose last day has passed stops rendering at the NEXT BUILD, not at midnight —
this is a static site, so nothing changes until something triggers a deploy.
The three seeded items are real and already public on unifiedcloudsensors.com's
Updates carousel, carried over so this page is not empty. Delete them freely.
Their cs/pl text is AI-translated and has had no native-speaker review, the same
standing caveat as the rest of the site's CS/PL copy.
